title: Rabbi Avdimi bar Tanchum
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan, chapter 3, end of halakhah 8: “Rabbi Shmuel in the name of Rabbi Avdimi bar Tanchum,” and Hyman finds no other mention of him. He suggests that it was written “Rabbi Shmuel bar Avdimi b״r Tanchum,” meaning that Rabbi Shmuel bar Avdimi spoke in the name of Rabbi Tanchum; in Hyman’s reconstruction, through the printers, the first “bar” became “in the name of Rabbi,” and from the second “bar” they omitted the abbreviation marks. This Rabbi Shmuel bar Avdimi is mentioned in several places and was Rabbi Mana’s student.

notes.text: Hyman’s negative observation and proposed printers’ transformations remain explicitly attributed. The repeated bar/in-the-name-of reconstruction does not itself establish two historical people.
